In this video, we will explore how to work with complex data types in PySpark and SQL, including arrays, structs, and JSON. We’ll cover all the important PySpark functions like split, length, contains, explode, and get_json_object, and understand how to convert JSON to struct types for easier data access and transformations.
All code and data files are available on the below path:
What you’ll learn:
Creating and understanding array and struct data types in PySpark
Array functions: size, array_contains, split, explode
Working with struct columns using dot notation
